load_mbd_musicgen: load pretrained MusicGen multiband diffusion models using get_mbd_musicgen static method
load_mbd_24khz: load pretrained 24kHz multiband diffusion models with configurable bandwidth using get_mbd_24khz
generate_waveform_from_emb: generate waveform audio from latent embeddings using the generate method on MultiBandDiffusion
regenerate_waveform: regenerate a waveform through compression and diffusion using the regenerate method
tokens_to_waveform: convert discrete audio tokens to waveform using tokens_to_wav with EQ matching
